info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Deposit Lending Virtual Account Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of virtual accounts tailored for deposit lending services. By allowing users to open and configure virtual accounts, financial institutions can enhance their offerings to consumers seeking personalized deposit solutions. The API supports operations pertinent to setting up accounts, managing account details, and ensuring compliance with banking regulations. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service providers looking to expand their deposit product lines.

post.summary: Create a new virtual account for deposit lending.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a virtual account specifically for deposit lending purposes. It enables users to manage their deposits efficiently with unique virtual account identifiers.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new virtual account for deposit lending operations. It contains the necessary information required to successfully create and manage a virtual account for customers.
